title: fisc page config
description: window.FISC_CONFIG: what site/app.js has before it fetches anything, rendered into the page's own <script>. Every object is closed, so an unknown field is refused at the export.

schema_version.description: The projection's own version, which site/app.js compares against its SCHEMA_VERSION before it draws.

exported_by.description: The export that wrote this page. Every artifact it links carries the same string as generated_by, and the client refuses a pair that disagree.

primary.description: The projection this page is of.

items.description: One published year with its words, built by the packager so the client never composes a figure or a caveat.

year.description: An integer with no floor: which fiscal years exist is data/sources.yaml's to say.

path.description: The column file this year is fetched from.

hero.description: One headline figure, already formatted by the packager, so the server-rendered tile and the one a year switch paints cannot disagree.

kind.description: Which tile this is, so the page can style a hero differently from the rest without reading its position.

items.description: One headline figure, already formatted by the packager, so the server-rendered tile and the one a year switch paints cannot disagree.

kind.description: Which tile this is, so the page can style a hero differently from the rest without reading its position.

items.description: What a chart page is given about a caveat: its line and the link to its paragraph. NO `text`: the paragraph lives on the caveats page.

counts.description: What the year's document holds, for the counts sentence.

lede.description: The year and basis as the lede names them; the template renders it and the client repaints it and names a column by it.

docs.description: Cited documents by doc_id, keyed by data and not enumerated: which documents a page cites is the corpus's to say.

additionalProperties.description: One cited document: its title, and for every page the site cites, the links a citation opens, built by the export so the client composes none.

pages.description: Page number to its links. An empty link is one this export has nothing to point at: no PDF URL for the document, or no records published.

pdf.description: The city's own PDF, opened at the page.

text.description: The committed page text; relative to the site, or absolute under --source-browse-url.

records.description: The page's fact-store shard, relative to the site.

overview.description: The page's own chart: its form and that form's hints. A cap on it names its own tail.

bars.description: The bars form's hints, present exactly when form is bars. The shape admits them; Go's validate refuses a bars overview, which has opened no node to list the parts of.

allOf.description: A chart of form sankey carries its sankey hints, and no other form does.
A chart of form bars carries its bars hints, and no other form does.

kind_labels.description: Each link kind in the page's words; project.LinkKindLabel.

split_labels.description: What each split key's members are called, in the page's words; the chip row and the chooser name a split by it.

wording.description: Every sentence app.js composes about the chart on screen, as templates it fills. `{name}` is a variable's value and `{name:one|many}` is the value followed by the singular or the plural word, by whether the value is 1.

counts.description: The counts line over a chart drawn whole: {links}, {nodes}, {facts}.

counts_partial.description: The counts line over a chart that draws some of its document's facts: {links}, {nodes}, {cited}, {facts}.

open_into.description: The hint on a chart whose nodes split in place.

nothing_opens.description: The hint on a chart nothing opens from.

fold_back.description: The hint's sentence on a chart with a node split open: the ways to fold one back.

chip_fold.description: One chip per node split open, which folds it back: {label}.

split_chooser.description: The accessible name of the chooser beside a node that splits more than one way: {label}.

tail_chip.description: One chip per tail drawn out, which folds it back: {label}, {n}, {word}.

expand_all.description: The control that splits every node by its first split.

collapse_all.description: The control that folds every split back.

follow.description: The hint's sentence about the isolating gesture.

expand.description: The hint's sentence about a folded tail, where the chart draws one.

swatch.description: The hint's sentence about the legend, where the overview draws one.

aggregate_label.description: An aggregate mark's label, mark.schema.json role aggregate: {folded} ids folded, {word} the plural noun they are counted in.

aggregate_note.description: An aggregate's source note: {folded} of {total} nodes the column held, folded at {cap}.

aggregate_together.description: Appended to an aggregate's source note once the folded chart knows its figure: {figure}, formatted.

residual_label.description: A residual mark's label, role residual: {grain}, the city's singular word for what the schedule does not split.

residual_rationale.description: A residual's rationale: {opened} the opened node's label, {grain}, {reasons} the step's declared reasons joined.

residual_note.description: A residual's source note: {flows} carried at this width, {where} the column's lede, {withheld} residual_withheld_one or _many led by a space, or empty.

residual_withheld_one.description: The residual note's clause for one leaving flow a narrower chart holds back.

residual_withheld_many.description: The residual note's clause for {n} leaving flows a narrower chart holds back.

residual_held_back.description: Said beside a chart whose residual this width draws no flow of: {opened}, {cents} formatted, {ends} the endpoints joined, {flows} the count held back.

residual_flows.description: A residual's two figures where money both enters and leaves it: {in}, {out}, formatted.

gap_label.description: A gap mark's label, role gap.

gap_lead_short.description: A gap rationale's lead where the chart above sends more than this one accounts for: {column}, {into}, {centre}, {out}, {gap}, figures formatted.

gap_lead_over.description: A gap rationale's lead where this chart accounts for more than the chart above sends: {column}, {out}, {centre}, {gap}, {into}.

gap_rationale.description: A gap's rationale: {lead} one of the two leads filled, {reason} the licence's, {gap} the difference formatted.

gap_kind.description: The kind a gap's ribbon is said to be, which no link kind names.

contra_orphan.description: The sentence a ribbon carries when a fold nets it negative with no printed reduction behind it; project.ContraOrphan.

balance_beginning.description: A fund's printed beginning balance, column.schema.json's balances.beginning: {figure}, formatted.

balance_ending.description: A fund's printed ending balance, column.schema.json's balances.ending: {figure}, formatted.

filter_hidden.description: The filter line's sentence for the ribbons the filters removed: {cents}, their figures summed and formatted, and {flows}, how many.

filter_folded.description: The filter line's sentence for the ribbons the smallest-flow filter merged: {flows} printed ribbons, {ribbons} merged ones, {threshold} formatted.

filter_hidden_at.description: Said of one mark the filters removed ribbons of: {cents} formatted and {flows}, how many.

filter_drawn_at.description: Said beside a node's figure, which is the view's, where the filters leave part of it drawn: {cents}, the drawn part, formatted.

smallest_all.description: The smallest-flow control's words where it draws every flow.

smaller_label.description: A smaller-flows mark's label: {flows}, how many printed ribbons it stands for, and {threshold} formatted.

smaller_note.description: A smaller-flows mark's source note: {flows} and {figure}, their sum formatted.

smaller_flow.description: A merged ribbon's sentence, said wherever the ribbon is described: {flows} and {threshold}.

search_count.description: The search's status where marks match: {n}, how many.

search_none.description: The search's status where no mark drawn matches: {query}, what the reader typed.

search_opens.description: Said on a search option whose mark splits in place.

search_expands.description: Said on a search option whose mark is a folded tail the chart draws out.

full_screen.description: The chart card's full-screen control, while the card is not full screen.

full_screen_exit.description: The same control while the card is full screen.

zoom_reset.description: The control that puts a zoomed or panned chart back whole.

bars_share.description: A bar's share of the node the bars form lists the parts of: {share}, the percentage formatted, and {whole}, that node's label.

hairline.description: Said beside a chart drawing ribbons under a pixel of its canvas, which are drawn a screen pixel wide: {n}, how many.

bars_hints.description: What the bars form lists: one bar per node at `tier` inside the opened node, each the sum of the cited links joining it to that node.

tier.description: The tier whose nodes inside the opened node are drawn as bars.

sankey_hints.description: What the Sankey form may fold and where, which the client's capColumn and foldDocument spend.

not.description: One canvas: a fixed height or a growth, never both.

tiers.description: The tier set drawn, left to right: a column order and not only a set. Absent on the overview draws the document whole.

items.description: How many marks one tier draws before the rest fold into a tail. THE PERMISSION, NOT THE FOLD: which members fold is the client's.

tail.description: The plural noun the folded tail is counted in.

height.description: The canvas the chart is laid out on, in px; absent lays it out on the form's own. The overview's only.

drop.description: Tiers whose nodes, and every link touching one, the chart does not draw: a tier the document emits as a restatement of the tiers drawn. The overview's only, and disjoint from tiers.

grow.description: A canvas sized by the busiest column drawn: node_px px for each of its nodes, held between floor and ceiling. The overview's only, and never beside a height.

split_caps.description: How many members of each split of the expansion schedule, by split key, are drawn before the rest fold into a tail inside the node they split. THE PERMISSION, NOT THE FOLD: which members fold is the client's. The overview's only.

tail.description: The plural noun the folded tail is counted in.
